input.value: fire started from grease flare-up on stove; extinguished with fire extinguisher
charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls
damage limited to kitchen area; rest of house unaffected

input.rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and walls is clearly property damage to covered residential property, with no liability or third-party involvement.

Substantial localized property damage (charred cabinets, smoke damage) requiring professional restoration, but contained to kitchen area with no structural threat to rest of home and no injuries. Likely within coverage limits.

input.claim_summary: Homeowners claim for kitchen fire damage caused by grease flare-up on stove. Policyholder extinguished fire with extinguisher. Damage includes charred kitchen cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Fire confined to kitchen area. Deductible: $500. Coverage limit: $250,000.
